searchText: did you folks find a way to deploy a contract? I am synced up to head with no problems. <@415548822983278593> did you deploy that contract? Ah sorry, had some small problems connecting to the testnet, didn't get to it yet should be good now though so will send a 3074 tx likely within the next few min chain now includes a 3074 tx at height 21875 I am definitely curious now if we knocked you off the network, <@!500419996652929044> 😉 you most likely did, but my laptop is closed... well, sooner or later you (and we) will find out! Enjoying the suspense until then... Schrödinger's node <@!415548822983278593> what time is it for you? Do you want me to go find out now? That can be arranged Haha, it is 6pm for me. But no need to rush, this is just my curiosity speaking. Just report back whenever you happen to next look at your node! yep, it failed! Now on to fixing 🙂 I guess was to be expected. Good luck! Also there is certainly a small chance our geth implementation is at fault, say in some non-obvious part like the gas calculation. we don't yet have great test coverage... but I did have a look at the tx result, and at least the core signature verification + authcall worked as expected
